rocketmq_ui_page_placeholder: Select a connection from the sidebar
rocketmq_ui_hint_namesrv: Separate multiple addresses with semicolons; the client failovers automatically
rocketmq_ui_field_secret_placeholder: Stored encrypted; leave empty to keep the current value
rocketmq_ui_field_access_key_placeholder: AccessKey (leave empty if ACL is disabled)
rocketmq_ui_field_secret_key_placeholder: SecretKey (leave empty if ACL is disabled)
rocketmq_ui_hint_acl: Leave both empty if the cluster has no ACL enabled
rocketmq_ui_tls_verify_server: Verify server certificate (a truststore is required for self-signed CAs)
rocketmq_ui_tls_verify_warning: Server certificate verification is off: the peer's identity will not be validated. Recommended for testing environments only
rocketmq_ui_tls_hint_truststore: PEM CA certificates (.pem/.crt/.cer) are used as-is; .p12/.pfx are parsed as PKCS12 and .jks as JKS, then converted automatically
rocketmq_ui_tls_hint_keystore: For one-way TLS (server verification only), leave both the Keystore file and password empty; for mutual TLS, pick a keystore containing the private key and enter its password
rocketmq_ui_error_tls_truststore_require: A truststore file is required when server certificate verification is enabled
rocketmq_ui_error_tls_truststore_passwor: A truststore password is required when server certificate verification is enabled
rocketmq_ui_error_tls_keystore_pair: A Keystore file is selected: enter its password, or click Clear to leave everything empty if you don't need mutual TLS
rocketmq_ui_error_tls_keystore_pem: The keystore only accepts JKS/P12 stores containing a private key; use PEM certificates directly as the truststore instead
rocketmq_ui_error_object_scan_range: Object scan interval must be 1 - 1440 minutes
rocketmq_ui_error_status_scan_range: Status scan interval must be 5 - 3600 seconds
rocketmq_ui_group_empty: No consumer groups in this cluster
rocketmq_ui_topology_empty: No displayable objects in this cluster
rocketmq_ui_topic_props_no_routes: No route info; the topic may not be registered on any broker yet
rocketmq_ui_topic_delete_confirm_text: Delete topic %1$s? This cannot be undone and removes all metadata from the brokers and the NameServer.
rocketmq_ui_group_props_no_rows: No offset data for this group (may never have consumed)
rocketmq_ui_group_create_name_hint: Letters, digits, dash, underscore and % only; immutable after creation
rocketmq_ui_group_create_name_invalid: Name allows letters, digits, dash, underscore and % only; no spaces or non-ASCII
rocketmq_ui_group_props_progress_unavail: Unable to fetch detailed offset info for this group.
rocketmq_ui_group_props_no_route_sub: The retry topic of this group has no route in the NameServer — usually because the group has never consumed (the broker has not reported it yet), automatic topic creation is disabled on the server, or POP consumption is used.
rocketmq_ui_group_props_failed_sub: Consumer progress query failed; click retry, or check the server connection and permissions.
rocketmq_ui_group_props_metrics_unavaila: Progress data unavailable (retry topic has no route, or the query failed)
rocketmq_ui_group_delete_confirm_text: Delete consumer group %1$s? This removes the subscription group config from all brokers and cannot be undone.
